summary: Lightspeed Commerce filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, presenting first-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results. The filing reports revenue of $322.7 million, organic growth of 17%, and a net loss narrowing to $2.4 million. It also mentions the divestiture of Upserve on April 28, 2026, affecting comparability, and share repurchases of $86 million (seven million shares). These are routine quarterly results and buyback disclosures, not a special-situation event like a strategic review or activist campaign. No material terms of a pending transaction are provided. The filing is a standard earnings release, so no special-situations category applies.
